summary: 1 blocker(s) and 1 important finding(s) must be resolved before merge.

findings.issue: The change reports success on a path it never verified.
findings.why_it_matters: A caller cannot tell a real success from an unverified one.
findings.concrete_fix: Check the condition before returning success.

findings.issue: The change duplicates existing behavior instead of using the shared helper.
findings.why_it_matters: The duplicated path can drift and create inconsistent results.
findings.concrete_fix: Route the new call through the existing helper and extend it if needed.

findings.why_it_matters: A future reader cannot tell why this value was chosen.
findings.concrete_fix: Name the constant and explain the choice.

findings.issue: Uses `os.path` where `pathlib.Path` is the local convention.
findings.why_it_matters: Inconsistent path handling adds friction when reading nearby code.
